Subject: Air-gapped activation: proposed window and signer delegation

Hi team,

We're upstream on the go/no-go cadence for the offline activation at our east-coast sterile site. We're proposing the following activation window: 2027-08-02 02:00-05:00 EDT (maintenance window). Before we lock that, two asks: 1) confirm the delegated signers who will countersign the signed image manifest at handover, and 2) confirm the emergency rollback gate and contact list should we need a silent swap.

I attached the current activation_manifest_v3.yaml — it includes the bundle hashes and required operator steps. Our security/compliance lead will require a named signer list and a scanned, signed copy of the manifest at courier receipt.

Can you confirm who within Redwood will be physically or remotely authorized to sign for CustCo acceptance? Also, please confirm whether Redwood can provide a DocuSign envelope for the pre-signed release so our auditors have a time-stamped trail.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of IT Ops, CustCo Inc.
(agomez@custco.com)

Thanks Alicia — good summary. We're aligned with an activation window in that early-August slot, subject to final courier ETA and operator availability. High level response below and next steps in the checklist.

Proposed delegation and sign-off flow (short):
- Primary delegated signers: Marissa Cole (Director, Release Engineering), Karthik Iyer (Security/Compliance on-call).
- Secondary signer (emergency only): Ben Carter (Field Ops).
- On-courier handoff: Edge Courier will scan the manifest and upload a receipt; we require a scanned copy + hash verification before the on-site operator starts the activation.

We will prepare a delegation_template.docx for CustCo to countersign; it will list the authorized signer roles and include emergency contact numbers. Marissa, can you produce the signer_roster.csv (names, phone, PGP key fingerprints) by EOD?

Rollback/contingency (brief):
- Canary activation first: 1 rack, reduced traffic, 15-minute observation window.
- If KV-store or model-signature mismatch occurs, manual silent swap to previous image (image_rev V2.9) — Ben will coordinate the swap with on-site operator.
- Post-swap forensic snapshot will be taken and uploaded to the secure drive; we will also open an incident on INF-4721.

DocuSign: we can create an envelope for the manifest and courier receipt; will include timestamped signature and PDF of the YAML manifest. Link will be shared once created.

Attachments: delegation_template.docx (template for CustCo), canary_runbook.md (draft).

Thanks — jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

We will perform manifest scanning at pickup and provide a PDF receipt and a SHA256 snapshot at handover. 2) Edge Courier to confirm driver badge numbers and upload pickup manifest scan by 2027-08-01 23:00 EDT.

- Silent swap order requires: secondary signer confirmation (Ben) + Edge Courier on-site swap support. Swap enactment documented in canary_runbook.md.
